bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 61
f="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/db_password"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$pg")"
test -f "$f" && test ! -L "$f" || exit 62
python3 -B - "$f" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os,sys,stat
p=Path(sys.argv[1])
s=p.stat()
bad_mode=bool(s.st_mode & 0o077)
short=s.st_size<12 or len(p.read_text().strip())<12
if s.st_size>4096:sys.exit(83)
if bad_mode and short:sys.exit(82)
if bad_mode:sys.exit(80)
if short:sys.exit(81)
sys.exit(0)
PY
